definition: to separate something into its parts
description: On an outdoor tennis court in warm evening light a young woman in a navy work jumpsuit, with sunglasses on her head and a long braid, kneels beside the bare chassis of a motorcycle and lifts out its silver engine. She sets the engine down on the court beside her and wipes her hands on a rag. All around her hundreds of parts are laid out in neat rows: bolts, springs, gears, cables, pistons and washers. Behind the net a young man and a young woman in denim overalls stand with folded arms and watch.

de.answer: Sie hebt den Motor aus dem Rahmen.
de.question: Was macht die Mechanikerin?

es.answer: Está sacando el motor del chasis.
